title: Icon-Only Segmented Control with Tooltips
description: A small round segmented RadioGroup with $size="sm" and $rounded="full", around segments that hold only a RadioCardSlot icon. Each RadioCard has aria-label and sits in a Tooltip, which shows the same word on hover and on keyboard focus. Use it in a toolbar with little room, when the icons are familiar, and prefer labels when people must learn the options.
